Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Brohm Caskfall. Character visual motifs: colossal cellar mechanic with transparent brass fermentation tanks, pressure-wheel forearms and rubber-stopper boots; no body-slam-and-exploding-barrel combo.

BOTTOM LEFT: Repressurize. Ability concept: reverses the direction of one active foam strip and gives Brohm a brief damage barrier proportional to Pressure consumed (capped). The reversal is warned by flashing arrows for 0.45 s; opponents may step off it.
